scope: Recommend user-facing wording and progressive disclosure for the current House polling inputs. This does not admit source data or authorize publication.

counts_and_units.unit: one selected poll-question result for one district, not one respondent and not necessarily one independent survey
counts_and_units.source_inventory_warning: The 1,628 ledger groups include other offices, cycles, and non-district records. Do not present 1,628 as a number of current House polls or call the 1,461 first-reason rows current House polls rejected for quality. Reason counts are mutually exclusive first-failure outcomes; exact duplicate rows inside question groups were silently removed and are not counted.

evidence.source_scope: The normalizer selects from NYT question records. The separately reviewed VoteHub snapshot is a coverage cross-check only, not an additional poll-row source. Its current-district inventory is contained in the NYT inventory except FL-28; the two FL-28 records share pollster, field dates, sample size, subject and source URL, and their March fieldwork is outside the 100-day window. This narrow coverage check does not verify every questionnaire or topline.
evidence.publication_boundary: The input review and aggregate-input admission are distinct from website publication. The selection receipt itself remains marked pending source and identity review. Show poll details only when the owner-reviewed publication artifact supplies them; do not use this UX note or its counts to imply a public release is admitted.

progressive_disclosure.placement: Near the selected live model's polling setting and in the district detail. Keep polling-off status visible without requiring expansion.
progressive_disclosure.copy_with_polls: Polling included: 167 selected poll-question results across 98 of 435 districts. All 435 districts receive a forecast. A district with no selected local poll can still be affected by polling information shared across districts.
progressive_disclosure.copy_polling_off: Polling is off for this saved forecast; no poll measurements are used.
progressive_disclosure.copy_enabled_zero_local: No poll-question result passed this model's selection rules for this district. The district still receives a forecast.
progressive_disclosure.copy_details_unavailable: District-level polling details are unavailable for this result.
progressive_disclosure.copy_guidance: Keep three states distinct: polling off; polling on with zero selected local records; and poll-selection details unavailable. Zero selected records do not mean no poll was conducted. Do not infer the polling setting from a district count.

progressive_disclosure.placement: One expandable 'How polling is selected' section, with short paragraphs or labeled bullets.
copy: Each count is a poll question used for one district. A single survey covering multiple districts can contribute a district record in each, so the 167 records are not 167 independent surveys.

The selection keeps one eligible question per sample and district, favoring likely-voter samples, then registered-voter samples, then adult samples; when more than one eligible sample remains from a pollster in a district, it keeps the latest fieldwork.

A poll's availability date is estimated as the later of its field-end date and one day after the aggregator recorded it. This conservative date-level rule is compared with the October 25, 2026 polling cutoff; it is not a verified original publication time, and later revisions are not tracked.

The modeled poll share compares the two named principal candidates: each candidate's reported percentage divided by the sum of those two percentages. Other responses are left out of that denominator; the share is not a candidate or party win chance.

Reported respondent counts are not added as a separate model weight. The selected set has no reported nominal sample size for 27 of its 167 records; those values remain missing and are not imputed. The model's calibrated total polling error already includes sampling error.

Poll questions and results can share a sample, pollster, election cycle, district, or nearby field dates. The model accounts for shared polling error; alternative questions from one sample are not counted as independent evidence.

progressive_disclosure.placement: In the selected race detail, show selected count and selected poll population mix when provided by the reviewed result. Provide included and excluded selection reasons only from owner-reviewed, district-bound aggregates.
progressive_disclosure.included_row_label: Selected poll-question results for this district
progressive_disclosure.included_row_unit: Records, not respondents or independent surveys. If source-question IDs are not public, do not expose internal IDs; counts must be bound to the result's authenticated selected source identities.
progressive_disclosure.zero_row_label: No selected poll-question result for this district
progressive_disclosure.zero_row_subtext: This says what entered this saved model, not whether polling exists for the district.
progressive_disclosure.excluded_row_guidance: If reviewed metadata contains district-specific exclusions, summarize counts by plain-language reason and clearly say these are candidate records considered by this pipeline. Do not label all 1,461 excluded ledger rows as House polls or display ledger-wide first-reason counts as district results. If no district-bound exclusion summary is supplied, show the zero-selected message without guessing why.

reason_translation_candidates.not_one_current_house_district: Not a poll for one of the current House districts
reason_translation_candidates.not_2026_house_regular_general: Not for the 2026 regular House general election
reason_translation_candidates.outside_100_day_field_end_window: Fieldwork ended more than 100 days before Election Day
reason_translation_candidates.unresolved_or_departed_candidate_in_ques: A listed candidate could not be matched to the reviewed candidate roster
reason_translation_candidates.earlier_same_pollster_race_sample: An eligible later sample from this pollster covers the district
reason_translation_candidates.reallocated_or_later_round_not_initial_p: Reports a later ranked-choice round or reallocated result, not initial candidate shares
reason_translation_candidates.outside_named_principal_pair_support: The model does not support this district's named candidate pair
reason_translation_candidates.alternative_question_same_sample: Another eligible question from the same sample was selected
reason_translation_candidates.unavailable_at_cutoff_under_created_plus: The estimated availability date was after the model's polling cutoff
reason_translation_candidates.missouri_fieldwork_before_final_old_map_: Missouri fieldwork began before the final map was confirmed
reason_translation_candidates.question_does_not_include_current_princi: The question did not include both named principal candidates

progressive_disclosure.reason_display_rules: Use a reason only when the reviewed pipeline reports it for that district. The ledger records the first failing rule, not every possible reason. Collapse non-House/non-district and wrong-election records into a broad source-scope category if needed; avoid language implying that a quality review rejected those records.

do_not_say: There were no polls in a district with zero selected rows.
167 independent polls or surveys were used.
Respondent sample size weights each poll.
The availability date is the poll's publication timestamp.
Poll evidence in every district is independent, or only affects the district in which it was conducted.
Input review or aggregate-input admission means the website publication is approved.

frontend_integration_notes.live_projection: The current browser race projection carries pollCount. A count alone cannot support district-specific exclusion reasons, population mix, pollster count, or source citation links; render only fields explicitly present in an authenticated, reviewed publication projection.
frontend_integration_notes.reuse: Do not reuse historical House polling-share widgets or their nominal fourteen-day cutoff copy. The live selection uses an October 25 polling cutoff and has distinct availability and dependence rules.
frontend_integration_notes.possible_summary_payload: A minimal reviewed payload could expose total selected question-district records, current district denominator, districts with/without selected records, selected population counts, missing-n count, polling cutoff, short selection policy, and district-bound selected/excluded reason counts. Bind each count to selected source IDs internally; do not send raw third-party source rows to the browser.
frontend_integration_notes.limitations: This note describes the reviewed source policy and inspected normalizer artifacts, not the completeness of all polls, a scientific assessment of the forecast, or permission to redistribute raw source datasets.
